ios.desc:
Fix blurry, low-quality videos in one tap. Video Upscaler turns SD and shaky
old footage into crisp 4K–16K — 100% on-device, so your videos never leave
your iPhone.

WHAT PEOPLE USE IT FOR:
- Unblur videos that came out soft or pixelated
- Restore old family videos and camcorder footage
- Upscale SD/HD clips to 4K, 8K or 16K before posting
- Convert formats and resolutions locally, no cloud

PAY YOUR WAY:
- Free: unlimited conversions with Apple SuperRes & MetalFX
- One-time: unlock a single premium export — no subscription
- Pro: BSRGAN & Real-ESRGAN models, 8K/16K output, full editor

CORE FEATURES:

• AI Video Upscaler
Upscale videos from SD or HD to sharper 4K, 8K and up to 16K output.

• Video Enhancer
Improve clarity, sharpness and visible detail in low-quality footage.

• Video Repair
Reduce blur and recover detail in old, compressed or damaged-looking videos.

• Video Converter
Convert videos locally and adjust resolution, format, bitrate, frame rate and size.

• Before & After Preview
Compare the original and enhanced result before exporting.

• Private On-Device Processing
No cloud upload. No remote processing. Your videos stay private.

AI MODELS

• BSRGAN
Premium restoration model for recovering detail in old or low-quality footage.

• Real-ESRGAN
Premium enhancement model for sharper, more photorealistic results.

• Apple SuperRes & MetalFX
Fast native on-device models for everyday upscaling and conversion.

TOOLS

• Advanced Video Editor
Trim, crop and adjust your videos after processing.

• AI Metadata Tools
Manage video metadata and automated suggestions.

• Export Controls
Choose output quality, format, bitrate, frame rate and resolution.

PRO FEATURES

Upgrade to Pro to unlock:

• BSRGAN and Real-ESRGAN premium AI models
• 4K, 8K and 16K premium export resolutions
• Full video editor
• Advanced metadata tools
• Watermark-free premium exports
• No ads

FREE FEATURES:

• Unlimited local conversions
• Apple SuperRes and MetalFX models
• SD, HD and 2K presets
• Private on-device processing

SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION:

Pro unlocks premium AI models, higher export resolutions, advanced editing, metadata tools and watermark-free premium exports.

Subscriptions automatically renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in App Store account settings.

quotes.text:
I make Video Upscaler 16K & Converter, a video upscaler and converter for iPhone.

The unusual part is not just “AI enhancement”, but that it runs locally on iOS. Most mobile tools either focus on images or send video to the cloud. My Video Upscaler processes video on-device, so clips never leave the user’s phone or tablet.

The free tier uses Apple SuperRes and MetalFX. Pro adds BSRGAN and Real-ESRGAN, plus higher output resolutions. Depending on the source and device, it can upscale SD/HD footage up to 4K, 8K, and in some cases 16K.

This isn’t a new landing page or research demo. The app has been on the market for years, and the main goal has been making local video upscaling practical on Apple devices while keeping privacy intact.

Current tradeoffs:
- 16K is situational, not the right choice for every clip
- long videos can be slow on older devices
- heavy compression and motion blur are still hard

I’d love blunt feedback on where the results hold up, where they break down, and which presets or export options are missing.
